title: Right to file civil suit
chapter: Chapter VII — Rights of Migrant Workers
text: Right to file civil suit.— Without prejudice to the right to seek a criminal prosecution for any offence under this Act, a migrant worker, if affected by violation of any provision of this Act or of the employment cont ract, may file a civil suit for compensation.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
verify_note: Text extracted from a third-party mirror of the official English translation. Compare with the Legislative Division PDF and, where the Bangla and English texts differ, section 48(2) makes the Bangla text authoritative.
